integrity_notes: All mathematical claims are proved for the stated exact model; computational checks are finite corroboration, not infinite certificates. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only exact positive diagonal systems, unconditional iid norm-squared row sampling and fixed row constraints are covered.
A zero-residual draw counts as one sample; rejection-resampling algorithms such as the stated Sun et al. Algorithm 1 have different accepted-step behavior.
The finite-completion stopping-time identity describes reaching the solution when every initially unpinned error coordinate is nonzero.
No computational-cost, numerical-roundoff, noisy-data or nondiagonal generalization is established.
Historical mathematical priority beyond inspected literature is not independently certified.
title: Sharp pinned-row selection and completion-time mismatch for diagonal randomized Kaczmarz
